welcome_lead: Tech's environmental footprint — and what we can do about it.
meta_desc: GCSE Computer Science stretch adventure on e-waste, energy use and sustainable computing.
final_note: You can argue for greener computing decisions with evidence.

walkthroughs.body_html: The world produces over 50 million tonnes of e-waste per year. Many devices contain toxic metals (lead, mercury) that pollute landfills. Recycling reclaims gold, copper and lithium.
Data centres can use as much electricity as small cities. Big tech firms are moving them to cold climates (cheap cooling) and powering them with renewables to cut emissions.

• Buy refurbished devices
  • Repair, don't replace
  • Choose efficient appliances
  • Switch off unused devices
  • Use cloud services in green regions
